subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: YouTube: Broadcast Yourself
description: A short lesson to help you apply YouTube: Broadcast Yourself.

hook.text: Three former PayPal employees wanted an easy way to share video clips online.

buildup.text: YouTube launched in 2005 with a simple upload button and a Flash-based video player.

discovery.text: The first viral hit — 'Lazy Sunday' from SNL — proved video could spread like wildfire online.

twist.text: Google bought YouTube for $1.65 billion in 2006. Many called it overpaying. It was a bargain.

climax.text: YouTube replaced television for an entire generation and created the creator economy.

punchline.text: Upload a video and the world can watch it.

quiz.question: How much did Google pay for YouTube?
